title: PUMP (master compressor)
author: Robbie (SETTINGS row adapted from digihealth by irpina)
description: PUMP for the Digitakt mk1, in place of the stock compressor: an SP-303 Vinyl Sim-style levelling compressor on everything the Digitakt plays. It takes the compressor's page among the master pages (FUNC+LFO), its eight parameters for its settings (so they are kept with each pattern, saved with the project and over a power-off, and follow SETTINGS > GLOBAL FX/MIX's global compressor), and its time in the render: the stock compressor and its sidechain no longer run. A = on/off; B = ATK: punch, each hit's front gets through before the gain comes down; C = OUT: output level before the ceiling, -32 to +6 dB; D = RAT: AUTO (set by CMP), 2:1, 3:1, 4:1, 6:1, 10:1, 20:1 or LIMIT; E = CMP: threshold, ratio and automatic make-up together, so more is always louder and denser; F = REL: release from LEVEL (slow levelling) through GLUE to PUMP (fast, breathing); G = WRM: soft saturation; H = MIX: parallel blend. The page: a record that turns with the tempo, a tonearm that rides in with the gain reduction, the eight controls and a gain-reduction meter, at 20 frames a second; YES swaps the record for a graph of the last 2.8 s of gain reduction; CLEAR (FUNC + held LFO + PLAY) puts PUMP's defaults back. Hold a knob and turn it for big steps; FUNC + turn jumps to an end. SETTINGS > GLOBAL FX/MIX > PUMP ANIMATION turns the animation off. Always on: a 30 Hz high-pass in the detector, and an output ceiling. On core 4.1's master output and master pages, so it is on every output: main outs, headphones and USB.
